Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq.qov.ph s. 2021 OILG OPINION NO. JUN 10 MS. JACQUELINE AGUILAR jacqueline.aguilar56@yahoo.com Dear Ms. Aguilar: This pertains to your letter dated 25 February 2024 requesting guidance on whether a Sanggunian Barangay Member can serve as Association President. We opine in the affirmative. A Sanggunian Barangay member may serve as Association President as no provision of law prohibits or limits the same. Freedom of association is a right guaranteed under the Bill of Rights of the 1987 Philippine Constitution. Section 4, Article Ill thereof, provides: "No law shall be passed abridging the freedom of speech, of expression, or of the press, or the right of the people peaceably to assemble and petition the government for redress of grievances" Accordingly, the relevant provision is Section 90 of R.A. No. 7160, otherwise known as the Local Government Code of 1991 , to wit: (b) Sanggunian members may practice their professions, engage in any occupation, or teach in schools except during session hours: Provided, That Sanggunian members who are also members of the Bar shall not: (1) Appear as counsel before any court in any civil case wherein a local government unit or any office, agency, or instrumentality of the government is the adverse party; (2) Appear as counsel in any criminal case wherein an officer or employee of the national or local government is accused of an offense committed in relation to his office. (3) Collect any fee for their appearance in administrative proceedings involving the local govemment unit of which he is an official; and (4) Use property and personnel of the government except when the Sanggunian member concerned is defending the interest of the government. Correspondingly, this Department has been consistent with its opinion that elective barangay officials are allowed to engage in other occupation other than the exercise of their functions as Punong Barangays or as members of the sangguniang barangay. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

Note, however, that in case of a punong barangay and/or a member of the sangguniang barangay who intends to practice his/her profession, must first obtain prior written permission from the head of the Department concerned as required by civil service regulations. Further, Sec. I(b) of Resolution no. 2012-668, series of 2012, issued by the Professional Regulation Commission, "Practice of Profession" refers to an activity/undertaking rendered by a registered and licensed professional or a holder of a Special Temporary Permit as defined in the scope of practice of professional regulatory law. Therefore, Sanggunian Barangay member may serve as Association President. Lastly, while there is no query pertaining to the issue of double compensation, we deem it proper to clarify that this Department has been consistent with its opinion that the prohibition on double compensation applies only to appointment to public office of position and not to a private office. Notwithstanding, this opinion shall be without prejudice to any contrary opinion rendered by more authorities and/or the courts. We hope to have guided you accordingly. Thank you.
